scope: User-approved polyp pilot: union-box localization and ROI verification; segmentation and image-area fraction. NOT instrument types/tips or clinical diagnosis.

data.confirmation: Entirely unused source groups under recursive 47-file historical audit
data.train_validation: Previously used development sources; no previous confirmation groups

learning.update: LLM-produced executable typed JSON skills from training rollouts and gold-derived feedback; no seeded candidate programs; frozen other prompts and weights

gate.require_both: quality branch requires both score and success gain; alternative efficiency branch has zero observed accuracy loss
gate.historical_reference: fixed committed end-of-T1 state, not rolling per-candidate allowance
gate.efficiency_accuracy_constraint: no mean score or success count decrease

evaluation.primary: S2 vs RAW, macro average of T1 bboxIoU and T2 Dice; paired by source group
secondary: actual skill invocation and primitive trajectory differences
S2 vs RAW efficiency: no observed score/success decrease on either task, mean primitive calls -1 and VLM calls -20%; descriptive only
evaluation.test_labels_released: after all final states and controls frozen
evaluation.claim: mechanism pilot, not powered clinical or broad continual-learning evidence

runtime.fixed_control: T1 global localize then one padded-ROI relocalization; T2 global localize then SAM then measure, standard untuned diagnostic
runtime.tool_preflight: 2 excluded cases: real localization and SAM/measure; target-box SAM is labeled oracle diagnostic only and never a runtime tool; require at least one oracle Dice>=0.70 before study
runtime.coordinate_contract: Reused physical input pixel FrameContract/CoordinateBoundary; no inferred coordinate scale
runtime.graph_preflight: Both tasks must produce valid answers with actual tools on excluded preflight images, no accuracy threshold

limitations: 8 independent source groups, 16 task endpoints, highly uncertain effects
positive-only polyp localization, no specificity or instrument claims
source groups rather than verified patients
same sources across T1/T2 within each role, task transfer rather than unseen-patient curriculum
SAM general pretrained segmentation tool, not a validated medical specialist
historical raw/abstract training here replaced by explicit trajectory records and executable skill transactions; extension of HCL gated learning, not unchanged original pipeline
amendment: Before validation/confirmation: role/catalog/coordinate adapter repairs after early training interface diagnostics; efficiency gate completes requested workflow objective; previous attempts retained, original clock and sources unchanged
